reasons: Cited Section 8.1 is a one-way Vendor (Commerce One) IP indemnity in favour of Corio (our party, the licensee) covering patent, copyright, trademark and trade secret claims, with defence/settlement at Vendor's cost, standard notice/tender/cooperation mechanics and the customary procure/replace-modify/terminate-and-refund remedy ladder — this meets the fallback and substantially the preferred position.

Section 8.2 exclusions (use outside Documentation; third-party modification) are narrower than the customary carve-outs and the rationale correctly notes there is no combination or specification exclusion, so no material term fails the fallback.

Section 9 expressly carves Section 8 liability out of both the 12-month fee cap and the consequential-damages waiver, so the indemnity is uncapped — better than the fallback's 3x super-cap and beneficial to us; correctly not flagged.

No reciprocal Customer indemnity exists, so nothing needs narrowing; the shortfalls identified (no express breach-of-law, data-breach or gross-negligence limbs, affiliates not named) are properly treated as sub-elements noted in the rationale rather than deviations.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the deterministic check (vendor IP indemnity present) passes; retained as internal evidence only.
